description: This file defines the GroupServiceModel class which represents a model for group services in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for constructing service models from XML DOM elements or directly via parameters, and invoking those services using a ServiceDispatcher.

classes.name: GroupServiceModel
classes.description: Represents a service model in a group, encapsulating service name, mode, and behavior for invocation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: GroupServiceModel
methods.description: Constructs a GroupServiceModel instance from an XML DOM element, extracting service attributes such as name, mode, result placement, and optional parameters.

methods.name: GroupServiceModel
methods.description: Constructs a GroupServiceModel instance with specified service name and mode.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the service ('sync' or 'async').

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service.

methods.name: resultToContext
methods.description: Indicates whether the service results should be placed back into the context.

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Indicates whether the service parameters are optional.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes the service via the provided ServiceDispatcher, handling synchronous or asynchronous execution based on the service mode, and returning the result map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the service model, including its name and mode.
